title: 🔆🔅Bandar Abbas - September 21 - Ghahramani, Head of the Hormozgan Justice Department: To date, the US terrorist military has targeted 420 fishing vessels and 340 commercial vessels.
text:
🔆🔅Bandar Abbas - September 21 - Ghahramani, Head of the Hormozgan Justice Department: To date, the US terrorist military has targeted 420 fishing vessels and 340 commercial vessels."

""
"SOT1, Mojtaba Ghahremani, Head of the Hormozgan Justice Department (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:38): "These are scenes of war crimes committed by the American terrorist army, which, by attacking a civilian target and the fishing pier known as "Posht-e Shahr" in Bandar Abbas, caused damage and loss to the livelihoods of many dear fishermen. You can see this both in the footage and through the traces and debris resulting from this barbaric attack present in the parking area.""

"SOT2, Mojtaba Ghahremani, Head of the Hormozgan Justice Department (Farsi) (00:39 - 01:10): "To date, the terrorist and criminal US Army has targeted about 420 special fishing vessels belonging to the dear fishermen of our province, and has also targeted more than 340 commercial vessels and ships. Both groups consist of civilian vessels and are civilian targets, and attacks on them constitute war crimes.""

"SOT3, Mojtaba Ghahremani, Head of the Hormozgan Justice Department (Farsi) (01:11 - 01:38): "The judiciary has recorded, documented, and evaluated all these matters through expert appraisal, and legal action and follow-up are currently being pursued. The executive branch, the government, and the esteemed governor are also, God willing, following up on all matters in accordance with the relevant circulars, guidelines, and regulations.
